items.title: Free Teen Friends
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These teen friends are free to do what they want. It might not be summer, school is still in session, but just relax and enjoy city life with your friends! Play your favorite games like skyblock or bed wars in stylish modern skins. They're bright, colorful, and a whole lot of fun!

- Cute and cool skins
- Perfect for teens
- Modern colorful designs
- 12 skins

items.title: Pajamas
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Pajamas are always super comfortable! Choose any of these cute pajamas to wear on your next Minecraft sleepover!

+ Cute pajama outfits
+ Includes Pajama Bee, Pajama Bunny, and Pajama Kitty skins
+ Colorful

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Big Babies
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These babies are big and have an attitude! Don't get too close!

+ Big baby skins
+ Cute
+ Funny

Big Babies by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Hacker Tools
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Hacker tools is a base with the most powerful tools in Minecraft. Explore the base and find all the different hacked weapons. Hack your way to victory with Hacker Tools!

- Secret base
- Fun with speed runs
- Sharpness 3276 sword hack
- Knockback 4821 stick hack
- Hacked armor
- Many tool hacks!
- Hacker guy and hacker girl skins

By 4KS Studios

items.title: Pixel Art
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Pixel art you can wear!
10 different pixel arts in 5 different frames.
One free skin!

items.title: Teens of April
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Get into the spring vibes with this teens of April skin pack!
Cute skins that prepare you for the liveliest season of the year, when the birds sing their songs and flutter around the city. Live your dream life wandering around in town in your most adorable clothes.

- 8 colorful skins.
- 1 FREE skin: Rainbow

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Teen Colors
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Feeling blue? Or is monochromatic just your fashion statement? Well, regardless, these colorful teens are experiencing each aspect of the rainbow one color at a time.

-7 colorful skins

items.title: Gods of Elements
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Master all the elements of air, fire, water, lightning, and nature with these mythical skins. Now no mortal will dare to stand in your path.

items.title: Valentine Chibis
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Eight Valentine skins by Cleora.

items.title: Lucky Block Houses
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Open lucky blocks and win a modern home! These houses are all furnished so that you can immediately use them as your new base. Besides the houses, you also have the chance to win all kinds of loot! It is also possible to craft the lucky blocks yourself if you want to!

+Modern houses!
+Over 100 outcomes!
+Craftable lucky blocks!

items.title: Luxury Cars
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Vroom vroom! It's time to get in your new luxury car and drive around the city! Choose from one of over ten super-fast cars! Or live in a luxurious mansion! Be rich in your new luxury car!

+ 10 fast cars!
+ 9 skins!
+ Luxury mansion city!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Rainbow Mermaids
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
It's time to explore the murky depths with these magical mermaid skins! 
Aquamarine blue and coral pink too! Be any color of the rainbow! Whether you want to wear flowers, crowns, or pearls, this pack is the one for you. It's time to dive in and explore the sea with Rainbow Mermaids! 

+ 12 skins with 2 skin tones each
+ By LuckOfTheSea

items.title: Gold Demons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Demons can be rich and famous too! Show off those expensive gold horns when you're strutting around the city with your gold attire. It's shiny, cool, and cute to be this devilishly fashionable. 

- Modern designs for teens
- Rich and famous gold attire
- Teen demon attire
- Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Mars Mission
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Life on Earth has ended and humanity has transitioned to colonize on Mars! By doing so, mankind discovered a problem... aliens got there first! They attack people and plunder their settlements. Grab your supplies and stop them for humanity!

+ Drivable spaceship
+ Aggressive aliens
+ Many places to explore
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Cookie Team
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
What is your favorite food? Our favorite food is cookies! They are very sweet and delicious. Do you want to have a sweet skin just like our favorite treats? This skin pack is just perfect for you!

+ 10 cute cookie teen skins!
+ 2 FREE skins!
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Monster Manics
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These scary monster skins are perfect for roleplaying and scaring your friends! 
* 40 dark characters!

items.title: Demon Teens
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Is your high school normal? Well be careful because there are some demon teens roaming the hallways!
* 36 scary teens!

items.title: Space Robots
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These futuristic robots are perfect for roleplay and adventures beyond!
* 44 awesome space robots!

items.title: Luckyblockers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
What is that shiny block you’re carrying on your head? It's a lucky block, of course! Some say carrying one around can increase your luck, but others aren't as sure. Equip these beautiful and shiny lucky block skins and test your luck now!

- 10 skins included
- Tons of luck
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Igonomic

items.title: Adventure Teens
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: Free spirits, living in the moment. These 11 teen skins are always on some kind of adventure. They've been planning their biggest one yet and want to take you with them! On the open road, sailing out to sea, soaring in the sky, laughing way past bedtime. These skins are cute, modern and a ton of fun. The perfect pack to create everlasting memories!

items.title: Villager Fashion
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: These Villagers have taken their fashion sense to a whole new, unspeakable level. Inspired by anime and modern teen styles, these 10 skins are totally cute and ready to set the standard for style among your friends!

items.title: Bee Keepers
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Beeees!!!!

Bees zzzz zzzzzz’z fly zzzz z zzz honey zzzzzz! Nest zzz zzzzz zzz flowers zz zzzzzz wing zzzzz zzz.

Zzzz zz city zzz zzzz zzzzz adventure zzzzzzz! ZZZZZZZZZ!!!

items.title: Super Teens
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The whole city is talking about the new superheroes! Teenage wonders who live in a techno futuristic tower, and they’re recruiting! What powers will you wield to overcome the forces of evil: super strength? Super speed? Controlling the elements? Fight corrupt government officials, forge alliances with space aliens, and save the world in these 8 super charged skins!

items.title: Mooshroom Dojo
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Mooshroom Dojo is taking new students. Are you in? Train among the 12 best and most agile mobs this fighting world has to offer! A black belt Mooshroom, parkour Guardians, brick-breaking Blaze, and let's not forget the infamous Creeper Kai, sporting brand new karate apparel. Kick it with these ninja skins, and keep your city safe!
